title: contract.Spec decodes a struct map by entry position instead of by key: a missing Option field shifts values, an extra key throws

target.versions_affected: 17.4.0 and main 5243062f (the code involved is the same in both; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: structToNative assigns the i-th map entry to the i-th field of the spec and never reads the keys, so a struct map with a field missing (CAP-86 sparse unpacking, for example data stored before an Option field was added) decodes to wrong field values, and a map with an extra key throws TypeError. A silent wrong value in decoded contract data, storage or call arguments after a struct migration; maps that match the struct exactly are not affected.

entries.expected: Spec.scValToNative matches a struct map's entries to the fields by key, gives null for a missing Option field and ignores extra keys
entries.observed: No corpus entry decodes a sparse struct map through a contract spec. By hand on 17.4.0: {a: 1, c: 3} decoded as State { a: u32, b: Option<u32>, c: u32 } gives {a: 1, b: 3}, and a map with an extra key throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name').

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's script on 17.4.0 (main 5243062f has the same code): Spec.scValToNative gives {"a":1,"b":3} for the map {a: 1, c: 3} and throws TypeError for maps with an extra key aa or z; the generic scValToNative gives {"a":1,"c":3}.
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-86 (sparse_map_unpack_to_linear_memory sets a missing key to Void and allows extra keys) and soroban-sdk 28, which unpacks #[contracttype] structs sparsely by key for every unpack, function arguments included.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on 17.4.0 before filing on 2026-11-19: the b-missing map decodes to {a: 1, b: 3}.

queries: stellar/js-stellar-sdk: every issue and pull request since 2026-11-01

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/js-stellar-sdk/issues/1912; this record restates the public issue.
